slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "Every rung, the same five doors?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A, label "Six Spaces": a ladder with six small tabs on each rung; caption "the 10-07 plan"
 Card B, label "Five sections", circled with a thick orange marker loop and a small hand-written tag "leaning": a ladder whose four rungs each carry the same five small doors; caption "Report, Work, Studio, Delivery, Related"
 Card C, label "Each its own": a ladder whose rungs are all different shapes; caption "a page per level"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: does a Run get its own page?"
Focal point: card B.
slides.notes: Options: Six Spaces at every level: Description, Idea Studio, Audience Report, Work Details, Runs, Delivery (Q01, 261007); The same five sections at every level: Report, Work, Studio, Delivery, Related (today's page); Each level its own page, built for what it holds. Leaning: the second. Still open: Does a Run get its own page, or only a pop-out over its Task?

slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "Four rungs, each holds less"
A tall hand-drawn ladder in the centre with four rungs, top to bottom, each rung with a short label and a small doodle beside it:
 rung 1 "Block": a box of folders
 rung 2 "Job": a gear with a few tool icons
 rung 3 "Task": a script page with a play button
 rung 4 "Run": a small receipt with a tick
To the left of the ladder, a soft orange curly arrow going down, labelled "smaller, more concrete"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: does a Job keep its own code?"
Focal point: the ladder.
slides.notes: Options: Block: its Jobs, studio/, related/, delivery/; Job: its Tasks, and shared code src/; Task: scripts/ and runs/; Run: run.yaml, its ticket, result/, passes/. Still open: Does a Job keep code of its own, or only its Tasks?

slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "The answer sits on its Job?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A, label "A report": a separate notebook beside a ladder; caption "reports/ beside the work"
 Card B, label "On the Job", circled with a thick orange marker loop and a small hand-written tag "leaning": a rung of a ladder with a speech bubble holding a tick; caption "the Job answers its question"
 Card C, label "In the Run": a small receipt with numbers; caption "the raw result"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: a Job that serves every question?"
Focal point: card B.
slides.notes: Options: In reports/qNN, beside the work (today); On the Job's face, the Job whose goal is the question; In the Run's result/, as raw output. Leaning: the second (proposed 261029, not settled). Still open: What about a Job that serves every question, like shared tables?
